root.label: William Lawrence becomes Democratic nominee in Lansing-area congressional district

events.label: William Lawrence becomes Democratic nominee in Lansing-area congressional district

slots.name: Democratic nominee
slots.sentence: In the Lansing-area swing congressional district once held by Elissa Slotkin, who is now a centrist Democratic senator, the party chose the activist William Lawrence, a founder of the environmentalist Sunrise Movement, as its standard-bearer.
